description: Two-layer support stand (rigid weldment, no movable joints). Two posts 220 mm apart and 310 mm tall, bridged by a tall rear plate and two horizontal shelves (lower top ~54 mm, upper top ~304 mm; 250 mm inter-shelf gap). The gap was widened by lowering the bottom shelf (so the upper-shelf pick height is unchanged), sized so a top-down gripper can enter from the open side instead of a near-singular horizontal tuck (docs/refactor.md R6). Shelves are 140 mm deep so an ~80 mm object rests with clearance and the gripper fingers can reach in. Bolts to the floor through foot plates with 4x Oe6.5 mm mounting holes. Authored at true metric scale (metric_scale 1.0, no scenario scaling). Authored by articraft from 2-layer-supporter.png; kinematics (none) live in model.urdf, this metadata carries only RoboSmith semantic annotations. Static support fixture, not a graspable target.

upright.description: stand upright on its foot plates, open shelf side facing +X toward the workspace

place_targets.name: shelf_lower
place_targets.approach_note: Horizontal -X side-insert (s7/s7b value, video-confirmed correct). Consistent with canonical_frame.front_axis=+X and task_poses.upright 'open shelf side facing +X toward the workspace': the open mouth faces +X, so the gripper travels in -X to insert into the shelf -> approach = -X (travel-into-shelf direction). standoff = drop - approach*0.17 then sits on the +X (open) side at lower-shelf height. EMPIRICAL CORRECTION: s8/s8b flipped this to +X based on a wrong 'open mouth faces -X (snapshot confirmed)' assumption; the s8b video showed the arm swinging to the wrong (far) side, reaching off the table edge instead of the shelf -> +X is wrong, reverted to -X. NOTE: our world-frame / approach-sign reasoning has been unreliable here (we got the open-mouth axis backwards once) -> trust the snapshot/video over re-derived geometry, and re-verify the frame properly before trusting any sign argument. descend/retreat are still forced Cartesian (collision-blind) -> if -X still flips IK, option c (route them through plan_motion) is required (docs/supporter_feature.md, docs/refactor.md R6).

mounting_holes.note: floor mounting through foot plates; not subtracted from primitive geometry
